llm_response.reason: The website uses classic scam techniques: urgency ('Only remains 12 free places'), fake social proximity claims, manipulation targeting sexual impulses and loneliness, and push-through questions with no actual service or company information. The domain is very newly registered and matches the usage pattern of scam/adult lure sites aimed at phishing, data theft, or further fraudulent schemes. No legitimate business contact information or privacy policy is evident; the site solicits personal action but never offers proof of a real service.
